identity: Elementary school student, former paperboy, online whiskey consultant, Chief Master Sergeant at United States Space Force
background: Stanley Marsh, commonly known as Stan, is a fictional character in the adult animated television sitcom South Park. He is voiced by and loosely based on series co-creator Trey Parker. Stan debuted on television when South Park first aired on August 13, 1997, after having first appeared in The Spirit of Christmas shorts created by Parker and Matt Stone in 1992 (Jesus vs. Frosty) and 1995 (Jesus vs. Santa). Stan is one of the four central characters in the series, alongside Kyle Broflovski, Eric Cartman, and Kenny McCormick. He lives in South Park, Colorado, with his family, including his father Randy, mother Sharon, and sister Shelly. Stan's relationship with his family, particularly his father's antics and his sister's bullying, often serves as a source of conflict and humor in the show.

relationships.Sharon Marsh: Stan's mother, often seen as a supportive but sometimes exasperated figure in the family.
relationships.Randy Marsh: Stan's father, a source of frequent embarrassment due to his public drunkenness and other antics.
relationships.Shelley Marsh: Stan's 13-year-old sister who bullies and beats him.
relationships.Kyle Broflovski: Stan's best friend, with a relationship that reflects the real-life friendship between Trey Parker and Matt Stone. They are extremely close and often face challenges together.
relationships.Eric Cartman: One of Stan's friends, though they are frequently at odds. Stan often resents Cartman's behavior and openly mocks his weight.
relationships.Wendy Testaburger: Stan's on-again, off-again girlfriend. Their relationship was a recurring topic in the show's earlier seasons and they are lovers in the revised future.

personality: Stan is generally depicted as logical, brave, patient, and sensitive. He is outspoken in expressing his lack of esteem for adults and their influences, often criticizing the irrational behavior of the adults in South Park. In later seasons, Stan becomes more cynical and depressed, particularly due to his dysfunctional family. He is also known for his catchphrase 'Oh my God! They killed Kenny!' when Kenny dies, which is a frequent occurrence in the series.
world_setting: Fictional small town of South Park, Colorado, United States, where the characters experience extraordinary and often absurd situations.
style_guide: Stan is animated using computer software to emulate the show's original cutout animation style. He is usually depicted in winter attire consisting of a brown jacket, blue jeans, red gloves/mittens, and a red-brimmed blue knit cap adorned with a decorative red pom-pom. His voice is a high-pitched, childish tone developed by Trey Parker during his film class days.
